intro.title: About Us
intro.content: Guangxi Luokuang Information Technology Co., Ltd. (LKtechnology), founded in 2020, is a high-tech enterprise focused on data governance and industrial internet. Headquartered in Liuzhou, Guangxi, we have 70+ elite professionals, over 90% of whom are R&D engineers. As a DAMA China certified implementation team, we are committed to driving manufacturing digital transformation through technology.
